'''Headhunter Four''' was the callsign used by [[Jessa Vandangante]]'s wingman when flying with [[Headhunter Flight]] during the [[Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. He was a member of the [[Vandangante outlaw techs]] and was a gray-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lafra]]. He had over four minutes of actual combat time prior to the battle.<ref name="StarsEnd" />
